parameters.query:
SELECT
  i.job_id AS requested_job_id,
  j.id AS job_id,
  j.topic,
  j.language_code,
  j.target_duration_seconds,
  j.status,
  j.current_stage,
  j.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
  (j.status='created' AND j.current_stage='intake') AS eligible
FROM (SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id) i
LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON j.id=i.job_id;

parameters.jsCode: const j=$('Prepare Semantic Intent').first().json;const r=$input.first().json;let t=String(r.text??'').trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'').trim();let o;try{o=JSON.parse(t)}catch{throw new Error('semantic candidate model returned invalid JSON')};const clean=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim();const raw=Array.isArray(o.candidates)?o.candidates:[];if(raw.length<1||raw.length>5)throw new Error(`semantic candidate count ${raw.length} is outside 1-5`);const ids=new Set();const candidates=raw.map((x,i)=>{const candidate_id=clean(x.candidate_id),canonical_name=clean(x.canonical_name??x.candidate_name),subject_type=clean(x.subject_type),context=clean(x.context),interpretation=clean(x.interpretation),discovery_query=clean(x.discovery_query);if(candidate_id!==`C${i+1}`||ids.has(candidate_id)||!canonical_name||!subject_type||!interpretation||!discovery_query)throw new Error(`semantic candidate ${i+1} is invalid`);ids.add(candidate_id);return {candidate_id,canonical_name,subject_type,context,interpretation,discovery_query};});const common={...j,topic_language:clean(o.topic_language)||'unknown',topic_kind:clean(o.topic_kind)||'other',semantic_candidates:candidates,candidate_model:String(r.model??'')};return candidates.map(c=>({json:{...common,candidate_id:c.candidate_id,discovery_query:c.discovery_query}}));

const j=$('Build Evidence Comparison').first().json;const r=$input.first().json;let t=String(r.text??'').trim().replace(/^\`\`\`(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*\`\`\`$/,'').trim();let o;try{o=JSON.parse(t)}catch{throw new Error('evidence-grounded topic resolver returned invalid JSON')};const clean=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim();const fold=v=>clean(v).toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu,' ').trim();const cyr={а:'a',б:'b',в:'v',г:'g',ґ:'g',д:'d',е:'e',ё:'e',є:'ye',ж:'zh',з:'z',и:'i',і:'i',ї:'yi',й:'y',к:'k',л:'l',м:'m',н:'n',о:'o',п:'p',р:'r',с:'s',т:'t',у:'u',ф:'f',х:'h',ц:'ts',ч:'ch',ш:'sh',щ:'shch',ъ:'',ы:'y',ь:'',э:'e',ю:'yu',я:'ya'};const translit=v=>[...fold(v)].map(ch=>cyr[ch]??ch).join('');const forms=v=>{const f=fold(v),t=translit(v);return new Set([f,t,t.replace(/^h/u,'kh')].filter(Boolean))};const rawForms=forms(j.raw_topic);const exact=[];for(const c of j.semantic_candidates){const values=[c.canonical_name,...fold(c.canonical_name).split(' '),c.context];const candidateForms=new Set(values.flatMap(v=>[...forms(v)]));if([...rawForms].some(x=>candidateForms.has(x)))exact.push(c);}const ids=new Set(j.semantic_candidates.map(x=>x.candidate_id));const evidenceIds=new Set(j.discovery_evidence.map(x=>x.evidence_id));let selected=clean(o.selected_candidate_id);if(!ids.has(selected))throw new Error('resolver selected unknown candidate '+selected);let policy='evidence_comparison';if(exact.length===1&&selected!==exact[0].candidate_id){selected=exact[0].candidate_id;policy='unique_exact_surface_form_over_longer_lookalike';}const chosen=j.semantic_candidates.find(x=>x.candidate_id===selected);let reasoning=[...new Set((Array.isArray(o.reasoning_evidence_ids)?o.reasoning_evidence_ids:[]).map(clean))].filter(x=>evidenceIds.has(x)&&j.discovery_evidence.find(e=>e.evidence_id===x)?.candidate_id===selected);if(!reasoning.length)reasoning=j.discovery_evidence.filter(e=>e.candidate_id===selected).slice(0,2).map(e=>e.evidence_id);if(!reasoning.length)throw new Error('resolver cited no valid evidence for selected candidate');let confidence=Number(o.confidence),margin=Number(o.score_margin);if(!Number.isFinite(confidence)||confidence<0||confidence>1||!Number.isFinite(margin)||margin<0||margin>1)throw new Error('resolver confidence or score margin is invalid');if(policy!=='evidence_comparison'){confidence=Math.max(0.8,confidence);margin=Math.max(0.25,margin);}const canonical=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.canonical_name)||chosen.canonical_name):chosen.canonical_name,resolved=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.resolved_subject)||canonical):chosen.canonical_name,subjectType=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.subject_type)||chosen.subject_type):chosen.subject_type,context=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.context)||chosen.context):chosen.context,intent=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.user_intent)||chosen.interpretation):chosen.interpretation,query=policy==='evidence_comparison'?clean(o.research_query_en):chosen.discovery_query;if(!canonical||!resolved||!subjectType||!intent||!query)throw new Error('resolved topic contract is incomplete');const reason=policy==='evidence_comparison'?clean(o.resolution_reason):'A unique exact surface-form match outranks a longer lexical lookalike unless independent evidence establishes an alias relationship.';const topic_resolution={version:'evidence-grounded-topic-resolution-v1',raw_topic:j.raw_topic,topic_language:j.topic_language,topic_kind:j.topic_kind,resolved_subject:resolved,canonical_name:canonical,subject_type:subjectType,context,selected_candidate_id:selected,runner_up_candidate_id:clean(o.runner_up_candidate_id)==='null'?null:(clean(o.runner_up_candidate_id)||null),confidence,score_margin:margin,decision_policy:policy,reasoning_evidence_ids:reasoning,resolution_reason:reason,candidates:j.semantic_candidates,discovery_evidence:j.discovery_evidence};return [{json:{...j,canonical_subject:canonical,resolved_subject:resolved,subject_type:subjectType,subject_context:context,user_intent:intent,search_query_en:query,topic_resolution,resolution_model:String(r.model??'')}}];

parameters.query: WITH input AS (SELECT $1::uuid job_id,$2::text script_text,$3::jsonb script_support,$4::jsonb duration_preflight,$5::text narration_engine,$6::text narration_model,$7::text narration_prompt_version,$8::smallint script_fit_passes,$9::jsonb evidence_json,$10::text fact_source_language,$11::text fact_primary_title,$12::jsonb topic_resolution), locked AS (SELECT j.id FROM public.jobs j,input i WHERE j.id=i.job_id AND j.status='created' AND j.current_stage='intake' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=j.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.job_evidence e WHERE e.job_id=j.id) FOR UPDATE), parsed AS (SELECT x.* FROM input i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(i.evidence_json) AS x(evidence_id text,source_id text,source_language text,source_title text,source_url text,passage_id text,section text,evidence_text text,selection_score numeric,selection_rank integer)), valid AS (SELECT p.* FROM parsed p WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(p.evidence_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.source_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND p.source_language IN('en','pl','ru','uk') AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.source_title),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.evidence_text),'') IS NOT NULL AND p.selection_rank>0), ok AS (SELECT l.id FROM locked l,input i WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(i.script_text),'') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(i.script_support)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(i.script_support)>0 AND jsonb_typeof(i.topic_resolution)='object' AND i.topic_resolution->>'version'='evidence-grounded-topic-resolution-v1' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(i.topic_resolution->>'resolved_subject'),'') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(i.topic_resolution->'reasoning_evidence_ids')>0 AND COALESCE((i.duration_preflight->>'exact_tts_required')::boolean,false)=true AND COALESCE((i.duration_preflight->>'prediction_is_advisory')::boolean,false)=true AND (SELECT count(*) FROM valid)>=2), ins AS (INSERT INTO public.job_evidence(job_id,evidence_id,source_id,source_language,source_title,source_url,passage_id,section,evidence_text,selection_score,selection_rank) SELECT o.id,v.evidence_id,v.source_id,v.source_language,v.source_title,NULLIF(v.source_url,''),v.passage_id,NULLIF(v.section,''),v.evidence_text,v.selection_score,v.selection_rank FROM ok o CROSS JOIN valid v ORDER BY v.selection_rank RETURNING job_id), upd AS (UPDATE public.jobs j SET content_model_version='staged_v1',topic_resolution=i.topic_resolution,script_text=i.script_text,script_support=i.script_support,duration_preflight=i.duration_preflight,narration_engine=i.narration_engine,narration_model=i.narration_model,narration_prompt_version=i.narration_prompt_version,script_fit_passes=i.script_fit_passes,fact_source_language=i.fact_source_language,fact_primary_title=i.fact_primary_title,status='processing',current_stage='script',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now() FROM input i,ok o WHERE j.id=o.id AND j.id=i.job_id RETURNING j.id) SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ins) inserted_evidence_count,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) job_updated,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=$1::uuid) scene_count;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const p=$('Build Final Grounded Script').first().json;const expected=p.selected_evidence.length;if(r.job_updated!==true)throw new Error(`grounded script did not update job ${p.job_id}`);if(Number(r.inserted_evidence_count)!==expected)throw new Error(`evidence persisted ${r.inserted_evidence_count}/${expected}`);if(Number(r.scene_count)!==0)throw new Error('WF02 must not create scenes');return [{json:{job_id:p.job_id,evidence_count:expected,narration_ready:true}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='script',last_error=$2::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error;
